errors.evidence: The list of x-axis categories is incomplete and contains errors. It omits '起点', '部位', '参照实体', and '形状'. It also mislabels categories, listing '显式实体' instead of '参照实体', and '正式距离' instead of '显式距离'.
The description claims the order of the categories on the axis is the same as the order listed in the text, but this is not true. The actual order on the chart is different.
The description states that the y-axis has a tick interval of 2%, but the y-axis has no visible scale or tick marks at all.
The value for the '空间实体' category (test set, gray bar) is 31.6% on the chart, not 31.0%.
The value for the '事件' category (test set, gray bar) is 21.7% on the chart, not 21.3%.
The description claims there is no obvious sorting rule, but the categories on the x-axis are clearly sorted in descending order based on the percentage value of the '训练集' (blue bars).
